name: Fire Arrows
description: Prepared arrows intended to carry flame into vulnerable materials, structures, or exposed targets.
narrative_effects: Supports ignition and fire-delivery framing through compatible bows.
Usually destroyed or rendered unusable after firing.

mechanical_effect.trigger: fired from a compatible bow at a target or material that can plausibly ignite or be affected by delivered flame
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to ignite vulnerable materials, create fire pressure, or deliver fire through a bow shot
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: nonflammable or soaked targets; situations where fire would not help; ordinary accuracy beyond the fire-delivery purpose
